Name: [Documentation] Every table has a description
Description: Tables must carry a description (TMDL /// block), taken from the data contract for data tables.

Name: [Documentation] Every measure has a description
Description: Every measure, hidden or not, must say what it computes and how it behaves across years.

Name: [Documentation] Visible columns have a description
Description: Columns a report author can see should be described.

Name: [Usability] Visible measures are in a display folder
Description: Measures live in display folders so the field list stays navigable.

Name: [Usability] Visible measures have a format string
Description: Set formatString so numbers render consistently in every visual. Text measures (built with the & concatenation operator, e.g. the home-page date) are excluded: a format string does not apply to them.
Expression: not IsHidden and string.IsNullOrWhitespace(FormatString) and not Expression.Contains(" & ")

Name: [Modelling] Numeric columns do not summarize (summarizeBy: none)
Description: Keys, years and bed counts must not be summed implicitly: beds and population are stocks and are only aggregated through measures.
Expression: (DataType = "Int64" or DataType = "Decimal" or DataType = "Double") and SummarizeBy <> "None"

Name: [Modelling] Code columns are text
Description: Region, discipline, facility-type and municipality codes carry leading zeros and must stay text. Matches the business names of the dimensions ("... Code") and the contract names kept by the hidden fact columns ("..._code").

Name: [Performance] Do not use floating point data types
Description: Use int64 or decimal columns instead of double.

Name: [Usability] Columns of fact tables are hidden
Description: Facts are consumed through measures and dimensions only.

Name: [Usability] Foreign keys are hidden
Description: The many-side column of a relationship should be hidden.

Name: [Modelling] Relationships are single direction
Description: Star schema: filters flow from dimension to fact only.

Name: [Modelling] No many-to-many relationships
Description: The model is a pure star with many-to-one relationships.

Name: [Modelling] No inactive relationships
Description: There are no role-playing dimensions in this model; an inactive relationship is a mistake.

Name: [Modelling] Implicit measures are discouraged
Description: All aggregation goes through explicit measures, which implement the semi-additive logic.

Name: [DAX] Do not use IFERROR or ISERROR
Description: Use DIVIDE for safe division instead of swallowing errors.
